verdict.rationale: Azure has an official, first-party Azure CLI. It runs cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS, Docker, Cloud Shell), is designed for interactive use or scripts, and offers tab-completion and JMESPath `--query` output shaping, which suit automated and agent-driven workflows. A community user independently confirms that almost everything can be done via command line. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-oriented features such as non-interactive/service-principal auth for the CLI and guaranteed machine-readable (JSON) output modes.
